scripts.dev:all: npm run kafka:up && wait-on tcp:9092 && npm run kafka:topics && concurrently "npm run dev:api-gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:task" "npm run dev:media" "npm run dev:workflow"
scripts.kafka:topics: docker exec node-microservice-kafka /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic task.events --partitions 1 --replication-factor 1 && docker exec node-microservice-kafka /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic media.events --partitions 1 --replication-factor 1
